profile.description: Rohan started reselling regional teas and spices online seven months ago. Sales are growing quickly from a small base, with thin margins, a few refunds and one payment dispute.
profile.income_note: About Rs 14,000 from part-time work at a family shop plus business profit; self-declared.

scenario.headline: Large expansion loan on a thin track record
scenario.loan_purpose: Rent a small warehouse and buy bulk stock to double sales volume
scenario.narrative: Rohan wants a loan far larger than his current monthly profit comfortably supports, with a short history, informal buy-now-pay-later debt and one earlier missed instalment. This is a thin-file case where any offer should be cautious.
